item.title: Dairy Queen has brought its viral cupcakes to Canada — here's how to get one
item.description: After going viral in the U.S., Dairy Queen is bringing its cupcakes (a.k.a. its single-serve portion of its ice cream cakes) to Canada.

item.title: Pattullo Bridge permanently closed as replacement fully opens this weekend
item.description: It's a bittersweet time for local drivers as the Pattullo Bridge has now permanently closed to all vehicles.

item.title: Ex-Vancouver Canucks centre breaks unbelievable Canadian streak at Olympics
item.description: Another former Vancouver Canucks got into the action against Canada at the Olympics on Friday, breaking an unofficial record in the process.

item.title: Vancouver Park Board begins bidding process for a new permanent attraction at Stanley Park Train site
item.description: Vancouver Park Board has begun the bidding process seeking a new permanent attraction to open at the Stanley Park Train site.

item.title: Olympic curling gets testy as F-bombs fly after Sweden accuses Canada of cheating
item.description: Canadian curler Marc Kennedy got heated during the tail end of a curling match between Canada and Sweden at the Olympics.

item.title: McDavid makes Olympic history as Canada cruises to victory over Switzerland
item.description: Canada's Connor McDavid has continued to deliver for his country at the Olympics, setting a new record after just two games.

item.title: Former CIBC head to become the first new CEO of Telus in 26 years, as Darren Entwistle retires
item.description: After 26 years at the helm, Darren Entwistle is retiring from Telus, with the company naming Victor Dodig as its new president and CEO.

item.title: Opinion: Why Metro Vancouver's long-term economic prosperity depends on industrial lands — not just housing
item.description: Housing affordability and supply gets most of the economic attention in Metro Vancouver, but industrial lands are vitally important, too.

item.title: New strategy by Vancouver Coastal Health converts houses into 'Small Care Homes' for seniors
item.description: Vancouver Coastal Health is launching a new strategy that converts single-family detached houses into Small Care Homes for seniors.

item.title: Sleeveless skier vomits mid-interview at Winter Olympics
item.description: Cross-country skier Andrew Musgrave left it all out there at the Winter Olympics, having a bit of a physical reaction
